title: Southern Orthodontic Partners Names Sarah Sharfstein COO
html:
Southern Orthodontic Partners (“SOP”), a leading orthodontic support organization, has announced the appointment of Sarah Sharfstein as Chief Operating Officer. In this role, Sharfstein will lead operations across SOP’s network of more than 120 practice locations, with a focus on building consistent, technology-enabled practices that prioritize hospitality and clinical excellence.

A recognized leader in the dental support organization (DSO) community and a founding board member of Women in Dental Support Organizations, Sharfstein brings nearly two decades of experience across orthodontics and the DSO sector. She spent more than a decade in leadership roles at Align Technology, where she led sales teams and built programs spanning training, professional education, and key opinion leader strategy.

Most recently, Sharfstein served as Vice President at Aspen Dental Management, Inc., leading sales enablement and field effectiveness for more than 1,100 practices and 15,000 team members. She built a sales coaching model, training programs, and performance management frameworks that brought consistent execution to a highly distributed organization and drove same-store growth. She also led the deployment of AI-enabled coaching tools that gave leaders real-time visibility into performance. Earlier in her time at Aspen, she created a clear aligner brand and delivery system and launched digital scanning across the network.

“Sarah’s appointment as our new COO starts a new chapter at SOP,” said John Nelson, Chief Executive Officer of Southern Orthodontic Partners. “She brings extensive experience in both orthodontics and in building training and standardization processes at scale. Her passion for the profession is infectious and resonates with both our operational and practice teams. She will lead us in ensuring we are building the best tech-centric practices of the future that prioritize hospitality and clinical excellence.”

Sharfstein’s experience bringing best practices to life across large, multisite organizations supports SOP’s mission to make each doctor and each practice more successful—clinically, financially, and personally—than they could be on their own. At SOP, she will lead practice operations, integrations, and organizational performance, strengthening the people, systems, and capabilities that help practices successfully integrate, grow, and deliver an exceptional experience for doctors, teams, and patients.

“I have tremendous respect for this profession, and SOP’s commitment to its partners is what drew me here,” said Sharfstein. “The company has built a strong platform, with exceptional doctors, talented practice teams, and significant investment in technology and support. I’m excited to build on that foundation, partnering with our doctors to scale what’s working in our practices and set the standard for hospitality and clinical excellence in orthodontics.”

About Southern Orthodontic Partners

Southern Orthodontic Partners provides strategic, operational, and clinical support to more than 120 orthodontic locations across 18 states, empowering its doctors to focus on patient care.

Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, SOP is working to lead orthodontics into its next era: technology-forward, hospitality-focused, and doctor-led.
